Your environment. Your rules.

Your infrastructure stays under your control.

Infrayard runs in your environment without a Solvia-hosted SaaS control plane. OCI credentials, Terraform state and operational records stay within your managed environment.

Review the architecture →Security and access →

Built by Solvia Lab. Infrayard grew out of hands-on work with enterprise cloud infrastructure. Speak directly with the founder about your workflow and deployment requirements.

  • Use your identity provider.

    Connect your organisation’s login system and control access through roles.

  • Work with your network design.

    Use supported existing compartments, VCNs and subnets. Review the requirements before deployment.

  • Keep operations traceable.

    Inspect lifecycle activity, protected requests and execution logs.

A few practical answers

Before we talk.

Technical requirements and operating details are available in the docs.

Explore the documentation →
Do engineers need to write Terraform?

Engineers use the portal and approved templates. Platform administrators configure the OCI environment and can inspect the underlying Terraform execution logs.

Explore cluster workflows →
What do we need to deploy Infrayard?

A supported Kubernetes environment, OCI credentials and permissions, an identity configuration and the required network connectivity. Your onboarding includes a review of these prerequisites.

View deployment requirements →
Can we use our existing network?

Yes. Supported configurations can use existing OCI compartments, VCNs and subnets. Routing, permissions and endpoint connectivity must meet the documented requirements.

Review network configurations →
Does Infrayard deploy our applications?

Infrayard focuses on OKE infrastructure and cluster lifecycle workflows. Application deployment and workload operations remain part of your existing delivery process.

See the supported scope →
How do we get started?

Request a demo to see the product and discuss your environment. You can then start a monthly production subscription or arrange an optional guided evaluation.

Read subscription and evaluation details →
